summary: A ~7-minute low-res (480x360), grainy raw capture of an Alligators Brno American-football game on an overcast/foggy Czech field. Most of it is distant, hazy, filler-grade wide game footage, and the final ~2 minutes (from ~291s) are solid black. A few real gems stand out: a sunlit close tackle (~41-62s), a physical line collision/block (~62-83s), a golden-hour coach-instructing-players human moment (~166-186s), a full-squad sideline unity shot (~145-166s), and a clean full-frame ALLIGATORS BRNO crest card (~270-291s) that works as a ready-made title stinger. Be selective — the usable material is roughly a quarter of the runtime.
